paragraphs.text: The Blood Avatar is a huge evil being on Arcavios , temporarily summoned by the Oriq Extus Narr .

The Blood Avatar is a massive and grotesque entity, drenched in blood, and exuding an aura of ancient and violent power. Rising from a fountain of blood, it has a vaguely humanoid form but is far larger and more intimidating. It wears a helmet of ancient bronze and wields four cruel, spiked weapons in its muscular arms, each designed for destruction. Its presence radiates wrath and a singular purpose: to unmake what has stood for centuries. Its movements are jerky and unnatural, a testament to its otherworldly origins and the chaotic power that summoned it.

Extus Narr summoned the Blood Avatar to unleash destruction upon Strixhaven . As the creature began its rampage, Will and Rowan Kenrith tried to stop it amidst the chaos. Despite their best efforts, the Blood Avatar's power and Extus's control seemed overwhelming. Rowan tapped into the Snarl 's energy, gaining immense power but at great personal cost. She temporarily disrupted the Blood Avatar, but Extus recovered and mocked her for her inability to fully control the power. Will devised a plan to intercept and control the Blood Avatar using a spell, with Rowan's assistance. Their combined efforts resulted in the Blood Avatar crushing Extus, but as it was pulled back into the Snarl, it lashed out one final time, grievously injuring Will by cutting his right leg off at the knee. The Hall of Oracles collapsed, but the twins were saved by Deans Nassari and Lisette . Though severely injured, the twins survived, and the immediate threat of the Blood Avatar was neutralized.
